title: Meal Timing & Mood

claims.wording: Could the actual timing of your meals affect your will to live?
Exactly 25.6% of teens who completely skip breakfast report suicidal ideation.
claims.note: Liu et al. Nutrients 2022 PMID 35267931. Cross-sectional YRBS 2011-2019. Do not place on public SNF pages.

claims.wording: This correlation has nothing to do with shame, laziness, or lack of willpower.
Skip breakfast zero times/week: SI 25.6%, planning 21.7%, attempts 14.2%.
Up to 51.3% of the effect is serially mediated by weight and depression over time.
claims.note: Liu 2022 is cross-sectional serial mediation 39.68-51.30%, not longitudinal.

claims.wording: TRE re-entrains the circadian system, heals the gut barrier, and clears neuroinflammation.
claims.note: Contradicts Wehrens 2017 master-clock markers. Hepler 2022 is mouse.

research_queue: Human review before any public numeric or suicide-adjacent copy
